name: 97267 · Milwaukie, OR
findings: ZIP 97267 (Milwaukie) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97267 (Milwaukie) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 97267 (Milwaukie) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97267 (Milwaukie) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
